name: Turkey Kofta Pittas
method: Mix the turkey mince with the grated onion, cumin, smoked paprika and seasoning and shape into 8 small koftas.
Fry in the oil for 8–10 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Stir the grated cucumber into the Greek yogurt. Warm the pittas and fill with the koftas, salad, chopped tomatoes and yogurt sauce.
